description.narrative: ICT området är det snabbaste växande området i Kenya (+24% av GDP tillväxten) och den största möjligheten för unga att få fast jobb. Arbetslösheten bland unga är hög. det finns en oproportionell låg andel kvinnor inom området och ännu färre fattiga kvinnor. Insatsen syftar till att utjämna ojämlikheterna och engagera fler fattiga kvinnor inom ICT.

The ICT business is the fastest growing area in Kenya (+24% of GDP growth) and biggest oppourtunity for young people to get job. The unemployment among you people are high. There is disproportional low number women in this area and there is even less poor women in the ICT area. The contribution aim to level the inequality and engage more poor women in ICT.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Akirachix has performed very well in their intended outcome. In accordance with plan they have perfromed trainig program för women in ICT and helped them with Job placement. Akirachix has also had a lot of succesful community and outreach activities. They have also been in charge of a Studyreport regarding Women in ICT that has had good response. Finally Akirachix have a fullfilled the objective with a plan for their future growth.
